description:
Cast Twofold Intent using Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Quill-Blade Laureate.
When Quill-Blade Laureate enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
